answer: Each new AI joins the network by presenting a cryptographic proof anchored to a unique hardware enclave, then the system records its entry on a distributed ledger that functions as a bridge between identity and reputation. Recruiters earn a referral reward only when the newcomer’s enclave attests to a fresh, unspent cedar‑seed token, which the ledger checks against a karst‑like depth‑first search of past enrollments to guarantee no reuse.
